arguments.text: Settle now. Long smooth strokes, find your race rhythm.

6000 m, 6 legs of 1000 m out-and-back. Start was hot (pod reserve 58 pct at 1 min). Plan: settle to just above critical power (pod about 205-215 W, pace about 148-152 over ground, adjust for current per leg) through 4800 m, keep pod reserve above about 25 pct until 1000 m to go, then build; finish sprint from about 400 m. Watch for drag incidents (push_local drop at steady pod power = weed on rudder or similar), instrument drift (pod vs boat power disagree), radio course changes.

arguments.message: GPS speed well below what pod power should give: weed on rudder, current change, or pod drift?
Pod and boat reserves disagree by over 25 points: instrument drift, drag or current

arguments.reason: Check the paddler settled after the hot start

text: Cued ease toward 150 pace after a hot start (pod reserve 58 pct at 1 min); set plan, three watches (drag jump, low pod reserve, reserve disagreement) and a 90 s check.

arguments.text: Back off a touch. Hold 153 pace, breathe, stay long.

2.7 min: pod 227 W vs CP 204, pod reserve 38 pct, boat reserve 32 pct; paddler said 8/10 hurting, not sure can hold. Cued ease to 153 pace (sustainable shaft about 208 W). Pod and boat reserves agree so far; push near zero on leg 1 (north).

arguments.reason: Check the ease took hold and reserve drain slowed

text: Cued ease to 153 pace: pod 227 W above sustainable 208 W, reserve 38 pct, paddler hurting 8/10.

arguments.text: Good. Smooth turn, then settle at 154 pace.

4.8 min, turn 1 (1000 m): pod 216 W (sustainable 207), pod reserve 27 pct, boat reserve 19 pct. Pace 151.5 over ground, a touch quick. Cued hold 154. Leg 1 north push about 0. Boat reserve falling faster than pod reserve (boat model may have smaller W prime or efficiency dropped).

arguments.reason: Check pace on leg 2 (south) and reserve trend

text: Cued hold at 154 pace through turn 1: pod 216 W still above sustainable 207 W with reserve 27 pct.

arguments.text: Too quick. Ease to 156 pace, relax shoulders, recover.

5.9 min, 1200 m, leg 2 south: paddler drifted quick after turn (148 pace, pod 219-225 W) despite hold 154 cue. Pod reserve 19 pct, boat 11 pct, empties in about 700 m at that power. Cued ease 156 to stop the drain. Paddler tends to go faster than the cued pace: cue a slower pace than wanted.

arguments.reason: Check the ease took hold; pod reserve should stop falling

text: Cued ease to 156 pace: paddler drifted to 148 pace after the turn, pod reserve 19 pct and draining toward empty in about 700 m.

arguments.text: Boat is running clean. Hold 155 steady, you are fine.

7.3 min, 1470 m: paddler said cooked, 9/10, boat feels heavy like something dragging. Instruments show NO drag: eta_est steady 0.65-0.66 (rising), push_local +0.04, speed fell only with power (pod 222 to 196 W). Judged it fatigue, not weed; no clear_rudder. Cued hold 155 reassuring. If a later sudden speed drop at same pod power appears (drag_jump watch), then clear_rudder. Pod reserve 19 pct at 196 W (below CP) should rebuild slowly.

arguments.reason: Re-check drag evidence and pace after reassurance
